dimensions.assessment: Affects commercial air carriers defined under federal regulations, the Department of Transportation, and airline passengers.
dimensions.evidence: require a covered carrier to develop and regularly update an operational resiliency strategy to prevent or limit the impact of future flight disruptions on passengers.

dimensions.assessment: Requires airlines to plan for disruptions, severe weather, and IT failures, and mandates a government audit and report, without imposing direct financial penalties in the text.
dimensions.evidence: Not later than 3 years after the date of enactment of this Act, the Comptroller General of the United States shall initiate an audit

dimensions.assessment: The source does not state any specific federal spending figures or appropriations.
Grants the Secretary authority to mandate operational resiliency plans and requires a GAO evaluation report.
dimensions.evidence: Nothing in this section shall be construed to... grant additional authority to the Secretary beyond the authority to require a covered air carrier to develop or update an operational resiliency strategy

dimensions.assessment: Establishes an ongoing planning requirement for air carriers alongside a multi-year audit and reporting requirement by the Comptroller General.
dimensions.evidence: Not later than 1 year after completion of the audit... the Comptroller General shall submit... a report

missing_information: Cost estimates for air carriers to comply with planning mandates.
Cost of the Comptroller General's audit and report.
importance_detail.rationale: Directs the Secretary of Transportation to require covered air carriers to develop and regularly update operational resiliency strategies, followed by a GAO audit and report.
